youtube.title: Isaac Newton lost a fortune in a stock bubble. Gravity won 📉 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Isaac Newton, the smartest man alive, lost a fortune in the South Sea Bubble of 1720. 📉

Team Sell or Team Buy Back? Pick one 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: Newton sold his South Sea Company shares early in 1720 for a nice profit, watched the price keep soaring, bought back in near the top, and lost around £20,000 when the bubble burst (millions today). He's said to have remarked he could calculate the motions of the heavenly bodies, but not the madness of people.
